title: Bradley Martyn: The Influencer
overview: A film exploring the life story of fitness sensation Bradley Martyn and his battle to keep his gym open during the COVID-19 pandemic. A story of the true power of influence, the right to free speech, and healthy living in dangerous times. The film also chronicles Bradley overcoming childhood trauma after his father's suicide, turning to fitness to inspire millions with positivity and fitness.
